first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses both the 4% completion decline and likely part of the 6% activation decline, with two inherited findings indicating durable activation and time-to-value gains. Verify memory_86 as the most directly relevant evidence and memory_73 because promotional pricing is the strongest alternative but has a pooled-cohort caveat. The experiment should track qualified revenue and downstream retention, not just completion or activation.
